package.description: The Zoom Skype for Business (Lync) Plugin allows Lync 2010, 2013 users and Skype for Business users to initiate a Zoom meeting from the contact list. If joining a webinar, users joining through Skype for Business/Lync will join as panelists.

en-US.description: The Zoom Skype for Business (Lync) Plugin allows Lync 2010, 2013 users and Skype for Business users to initiate a Zoom meeting from the contact list. If joining a webinar, users joining through Skype for Business/Lync will join as panelists.
en-US.name: Zoom Skype for Business Plugin
